# V2 numerical freeze proposal

**Pre-implementation evidence and recommendations, not automatic academic approval.** Source authority is Professor_Meeting_Clarifications_DQN_Dynamic_Pricing_Explanation.docx, especially sections1–6 and9–10. Only existing safe-period cache/count artifacts used. No production changes or training. All recommendations condition on the explicitly unresolved sign/resolution rules. Fit results are descriptive in-sample evidence, not approved runtime parameters.

## 1. References and exact population

P_base candidate22.354198442390455 is exactly the existing count-weighted Array-a mean over[1,75)km (7,946,921 trips), reproducing the professor document calibration. It is **not** the mean over the newly specified[1.5,75) scope (6,967,155 trips): that mean is24.20370974379068. Recommend retaining the supplied document reference with this provenance explicitly confirmed; do not silently relabel its population or replace it with24.2037. **P_BASE_READY_TO_FREEZE=NO until that distinction is confirmed.** Full precision in future config, rounded22.3542 only for display; no config written.

Recommend L_base4.616983790655043km as the interpolated curve crossing rather than4.5bin lower edge. This is a normalization reference in the passenger ceiling, not a minimum fare or meter distance. At fixed positive e and L>0, changing4.5 to4.61698 lowers P_max by P_base*L/e*(1/4.5−1/4.61698). Controlled evaluation using the same observed positive e values gives median reduction$0.373662, P95$2.034166, P99$6.970463. P_max quartiles are not inferred as offer distributions. At4.5 its P5/median/P95/P99 are8.815872/17.767771/71.433422/88.132986; at4.61698,8.6/17/70/84.6. The latter reconstructs observed paired fares algebraically; this is reference sensitivity, **not independent sampling validation**. **L_BASE_READY_TO_FREEZE=NO** pending numerical confirmation, although interpolation is the recommendation. No alpha×P_ref revisited.

## 4. Grouped distribution comparison

354groups have>=500positive observations. **1,062 fit attempts**: gamma, lognormal and normal truncated to(0,infinity), with354perfamily. No upper truncation silently invented. Full samples are represented by exact duplicate weights; no fitting subsample. Gamma and lognormal full weighted MLE; positive-truncated normal optimized over mu/sigma and log(sigma), three starting points. All354 truncated-normal attempts hit mu/sigma=-30search boundary: **not converged finite MLEs**, no finalized parameters. Their near-exponential boundary likelihood/parameters are diagnostic only; no claim the finite-bound optimizer is a valid fitted final family. A finite upper truncation could change the model and requires explicit support approval.

Lognormal has lowest AIC among admissible converged candidates in all354groups (including187at>=5000). No forced pooled family was used; each group independently estimated. However median groupKS≈0.1052 and median relativeP99error≈−49.94%; lognormal is a comparative leader, **not a validated final sampler**. Tail evidence and sign/resolution rules leave family pergroup MORE_EVIDENCE_REQUIRED. No per-group formal KS p-values; parameter fitting, ties and time dependence invalidate naive IID testing. AIC/BIC compare same group/component only.

Complete group counts and pergroup parameters/likelihood/AIC/BIC/KS/quantiles/lower-tail probabilities are embedded below to honor the four-file limit. Failed truncated-normal boundary estimates are labelled. Empirical CDF comparator is represented by empirical quantile/probability columns, not a parametric winner. Only positive-component data enter these three fits; negative/zero/invalid counts remain separate.

## 5. Drop-off update held-out test

Reuse persisted destination_popularity.parquet dropoff_count only; filteredTimeSlotJan1–Mar15. These are historical spatial-population completed drop-offs, **not** the sensitivity population. Proposed global142destination probability vector. Initialize Jan1–7count proportions; warm/update Jan8–Feb28; score sequential one-step forecasts onMar1–15 **before** applying each observed slot update.720slots,719nonempty scored,1,950,072drop-offs; one zero-count slot carries prior. Predictions never use same-slot future counts. Initial zero coordinates are allowed; logscore uses1e−12 numerical floor only, not added pseudocounts. Lambda tuning uses this safe validation block, not a protected final test. Runtime initial-history cutoff must precede its first slot; no fullJan–Mar initialization.

p_next=(1−lambda)p_current+lambda*observed_proportion. Observed proportion uses completed destination drop-offs, not commitments. Empty slot carries forward. Compare count-weighted multiclass CE (primary), Brier and average update TV (stability):

This supports an engineering freeze for the proposed globalEWMA model, subject to causal initialization/scope approval. It does not validate probability updates driven by a changed simulator policy. Historical six-slot ordinal popularity remains separate; do not overwrite it with probabilities.

## 6. Request and reward recommendations

REJECTED=0, bypass dispatch; ACCEPTED_DISPATCHED=P_offer at allotment; ACCEPTED_UNMATCHED=0 recommended because no ride/revenue allotted, pending explicit confirmation of source shorthand. No penalty or fictitious revenue. Aggregation A total assigned fare maximizes realized revenue; B mean successful fare ignores how many passengers are served and can reward serving one expensive request; C total/offered optimizes yield per request rather than total revenue and changes weighting across slots. RecommendA, optional **fixed positive scale** for numerical conditioning (not per-slot denominator); scale remains unselected. State demand/supply and matched-seed stratified evaluation help separate volume effects; total revenue cannot mathematically be volume-invariant while preserving total-revenue objective. No normalization silently adopted.

Gamma candidate0.99 explicitly per30minutes, half-life34.48hours. Compare0.95half-life6.76hours and0.995half-life69.14hours conceptually; no training/search. Horizon is an academic objective choice, **not inherited request gamma**. Slot gamma remains ACADEMIC_CONFIRMATION_REQUIRED.
